Name: Rebirth
Author: TheOneHermes
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=yellow]REBIRTH[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][b]
Welcome to Rebirth, a mod for Stardew Valley that allows you to customize the number of lives you have before your save file is deleted upon death.
Now, you can tailor your gameplay experience to suit your preferences, adding an extra layer of challenge and excitement![/b]


[color=yellow][/color][color=yellow][b][u]Features[/u][/b][/color]

Customizable Lives: Set the number of lives according to your preference, ranging from 1 to 10.

Death Messages: Experience a variety of unique and immersive death messages to keep your gameplay engaging.

Seamless Integration: Easily configure your settings in-game using the Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM).

TO BE ADDED: CO-OP compatibility ,
Translations

[color=yellow]

[/color][b][color=yellow][u]Installation[/u][/color][/b]

Download and install the latest version of SMAPI.

Download the Rebirth mod files.

Extract the contents of the downloaded zip file into your Mods folder.

Ensure that the Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) is also installed in your Mods folder for in-game configuration.

[color=yellow][b][u]How to Use[/u][/b][/color]

Launch Stardew Valley with SMAPI.

Access the configuration settings from the main menu by selecting Mods and then Rebirth.

Adjust the Max Lives option to set the desired number of lives before your save is deleted.

Enjoy your enhanced Stardew Valley experience with the safety of multiple lives!

Configuration Options
Max Lives:

Adjust the maximum number of lives before the save file is deleted.

Range: 1-10[/center]

[center][color=green]Change Log[/color]
 
Version 2.0 release

New Features

•    Custom Death Messages: Added support for multiple custom death messages. Users can now set custom death messages through the configuration menu.

•    Damage Multiplier: Introduced a new configuration option to set a damage multiplier for player damage.

•    Delete Save Option: Added a new configuration option to delete the save file when the player runs out of lives.

Changes

•    Death Messages: The deathMessages list has been moved to the ModConfig class and renamed to CustomDeathMessages.

•    Reset Player: Modified the ResetPlayer method to only delete the regular save and not the backup save.

Bug Fixes

•    Exception Handling: Improved exception handling in the ResetPlayer and DeleteDirectory methods to log specific exceptions like IOException and UnauthorizedAccessException.

Configuration

•    ModConfig Class: Added new properties DeleteSave and DamageMultiplier to the ModConfig class.



Version 1.0.0: Initial Release

Added customizable lives feature.

Implemented unique death messages.

Integrated with Generic Mod Config Menu for easy configuration.[/center]
[center][color=orange]Compatibility[/color]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.6+.

Requires SMAPI 3.0+.

Requires Generic Mod Config Menu.
